steps: Open the base URL in a fresh desktop tab.
expected: Home renders with one H1, visible address/ID input, named Search button, example and footer.
actual: Observed at 1363 × 936 CSS pixels.

steps: Inspect every home section and the footer at the baseline desktop size.
expected: No clipped text, overlap or horizontal page scroll. Main content follows consistent gutters.
actual: No horizontal overflow; readable desktop sections. Separate specific alignment defects recorded below.

steps: Read all visible home copy against the approved content inventory.
expected: Meaning, spelling, terminology and CTAs are consistent; examples are clearly fictional.
actual: No obvious spelling error; example is explicitly fictional. Recommendations are in the copy review.

steps: Inspect the active release banner and compare with data-release metadata.
expected: Year, phase and source dates match approved data metadata and are clearly scoped.
actual: 2026 certified and Jul 18 agree with search labels; authoritative import metadata was not queried.

steps: Activate header Search, About and Support us; inspect destinations.
expected: Each link reaches a relevant, visible section without obscuring its heading.
actual: All three clicked and relevant sections observed. Settled Search input top=52.7 px; About section top=174.8 px.

steps: Activate footer Data & methodology.
expected: Destination explains sources, calculation methods and limitations or links to that information.
actual: Lands on Independent by design introductory text, not methodology. F02.

steps: Activate Homeowner questions.
expected: Reaches the homeowner-question section.
actual: Target contains all five homeowner questions.

steps: Activate Search my property using the keyboard; inspect focus.
expected: Scrolls to search and puts keyboard focus on the search input.
actual: Scrolls to search but document.activeElement remains the CTA link. F06.

steps: Inspect the footer external TCAD link at 1363 × 936.
expected: Arrow stays with the link label and does not form an orphan line.
actual: Official Appraisal District search arrow appears on a separate line. F04.

steps: Compare vertical text positions of Property and Market value column headers.
expected: Header text baselines align; currency column aligns with header.
actual: Text tops 465.953 and 478.953 pixels: 13 px vertical mismatch. F03.

steps: Open Contact, Report a data issue, Support, Privacy, Terms and Accessibility from their observed footer URLs.
expected: All six destinations render relevant content without 404 or app errors.
actual: All six loaded. This is a destination smoke test, not legal-content approval.

steps: Follow Support → Continue to secure checkout; inspect destination without paying.
expected: Approved Stripe destination loads; no contribution is charged.
actual: Configured Stripe URL loaded Systems & Sense, LLC / Support ParcelSavvy checkout with $10 displayed. No information entered and no payment submitted.

steps: Open each official TCAD footer link.
expected: Reaches the official property-search destination.
actual: Both share the same URL. Destination resolved to https://traviscad.org/propertysearch and rendered PROPERTY SEARCH with an official search link.

steps: Open Suggest a feature or metric; press Escape.
expected: Named dialog opens, Close receives focus, Escape closes, focus returns to trigger.
actual: All observed; no suggestion was submitted.

steps: In a disposable test environment, submit blank, 9, 10, 2000 and 2001 characters; test success/error.
expected: Validation boundaries work; success appears once; error retains text and allows retry.
actual: No external messages or feedback records created.

steps: Search 1104 Paw Print by clicking Search.
expected: Includes 1104 PAW PRINT, ID 736302; selected property remains consistent.
actual: One result: ID 736302.

steps: Search property ID 736302.
expected: Returns the same property as the street address.
actual: ID 736302, $1,285,275 in displayed 2026 certified snapshot.

steps: Search 1104 Paw.
expected: Partial address returns ID 736302.
actual: One correct matching result.

steps: Search "  1104 paw print  ".
expected: Case and leading/trailing spaces do not alter property identity.
actual: Query trimmed; ID 736302 returned.

steps: Search "1104  Paw   Print".
expected: Repeated internal spaces normalize and return ID 736302.
actual: ID 736302 returned.

steps: Search "1104 Paw Print, Leander, TX 78641".
expected: Pasted full address returns ID 736302.
actual: No matches in suggestions or submitted results. F01.

steps: Compare "1104 Paw Print Leander TX" with "1104 Paw Print Leander 78641".
expected: Both return ID 736302.
actual: TX variant returns no matches; city+ZIP variant returns correct property. State-token handling is implicated, not proven from code. F01.

steps: Search "1104 Paw Print,"; "1104 Paw Print Leander"; "1104 Paw Print 78641".
expected: Punctuation, city and ZIP variants return ID 736302.
actual: All three returned correct property.

steps: Search West 36th Street and W 36 St; compare ordered IDs.
expected: Directional, suffix and ordinal variants return consistent results.
actual: Both first pages show the same 20 IDs beginning 121385; expanded search has 38 results across two pages.

steps: Search 1104 Paw Prnit.
expected: Typo recovery proposes the correct property and clearly labels approximate matches.
actual: Possible matches and caution displayed; ID 736302 returned.

steps: Search 1905 W 36 St Unit B and 1905 W 36 St #B.
expected: Both return unit B, ID 799047, without substituting unit A.
actual: Both returned unit B, ID 799047.

steps: Search zzzzqaunmatched999.
expected: Clear no-results state with actionable recovery; no stale rows.
actual: No matching addresses; spelling/street-name guidance shown.

steps: Search nonexistent numeric ID 999999999.
expected: No-result copy supports property-ID search and recommends checking the ID.
actual: Shows No matching addresses found and only address-oriented recovery. F07.

steps: Clear the input completely; click Search.
expected: Remain in place; required-field validation focuses input.
actual: Please fill out this field; focus on address-search.

steps: Enter three spaces; click Search.
expected: Trim before validation; stay in place with a useful required-field message.
actual: Navigates to /?q= and renders home without an explanation. F05.

steps: Fill 120 characters, then type one additional character using real keyboard input.
expected: Input remains capped at 120; does not crash.
actual: Additional character ignored; value length 120. Programmatic fill can bypass the limit and was excluded as a user-input defect.

steps: Paste 121 and 1000 characters; submit encoded long-query URL in isolated tests.
expected: UI and server enforce documented bounds and show useful feedback.
actual: Keyboard limit checked; paste and server-side bounds not tested.

steps: Search approved fixtures for fractional house numbers, hyphenated names, apostrophes and Unicode.
expected: Identity is preserved; encoding is safe; no false substitutions.
actual: 1104 1/2 FIESTA ST and 1104 1/2 TILLERY ST appeared as suggestions, but their direct search paths were not tested.

steps: Test one-character, two-character and house-number-only submissions.
expected: Minimum-query behavior is intentional and explained; no unbounded scan or misleading zero result.
actual: House-number-only suggestions tested; minimum-length boundaries and broad submitted search pending.

steps: Compare suggestion and submitted-search IDs for each approved fixture.
expected: Correct property appears consistently; no unrelated exact-ID match.
actual: Consistency checked for 1104 Paw and 736302; county-wide fixture set pending.

steps: Type 1104; then 1104 Paw.
expected: At most the intended number of suggestions; narrowing shows ID 736302.
actual: Eight house-number suggestions; one result after narrowing.

steps: Type a known address and observe the pending state.
expected: Visible and programmatic loading status; no misleading empty flash.
actual: Finding matching addresses… observed in both visible text and status. Flash duration not instrumented.

steps: Type 1102 Paw; ArrowDown; Enter.
expected: Active option is identified through ARIA; Enter opens selected ID 736303.
actual: Correct property route opened; aria-activedescendant observed on selection.

steps: Type 1104 Paw; click the matching option.
expected: Opens property 736302 with useful return-to-results context.
actual: Opened /property/736302?q=1104+Paw&page=0.

steps: With suggestions open, press Escape; then clear input.
expected: Escape closes without erasing query; clear removes options and closes list.
actual: aria-expanded false; query retained on Escape; zero options after clear.

steps: Rapidly replace 1104 Paw → 1402 High → 1102 Paw.
expected: Final suggestions correspond only to the last query.
actual: Final list contained 1102 PAW PRINT, ID 736303. Natural network order only.

steps: Delay response A by 2 seconds and response B by 100 ms; enter A then B; release both.
expected: A never overwrites B; selection cannot navigate to an old-query property.
actual: Controlled response reordering unavailable.

steps: Start slow suggestion request; clear input or navigate away before it completes.
expected: No resurrected popup, stale rows or unmounted-state error.
actual: Immediate clear passed; delayed-response case pending.

steps: Use ArrowUp/Down through first and last items, Tab and Shift+Tab, Escape and click outside.
expected: Documented boundaries; no focus trap; popup closes appropriately; focus remains visible.
actual: ArrowDown and Escape checked; full boundary and Tab sequence pending.

steps: Repeat a previous query after clearing.
expected: Cached options remain correct; cache cannot override a newer query or dataset version.
actual: Repeated 1104 Paw returned correct cached options quickly; invalidation not tested.

steps: After suggestions are dismissed, press Enter.
expected: Submits the typed query and renders matching results.
actual: 1104 Paw submitted; results URL and one match confirmed.

steps: Submit a search and inspect pending UI.
expected: Search becomes disabled and says Searching… while pending.
actual: Disabled Searching… observed. Duplicate request count not measured.

steps: Search West 36th Street; select Next.
expected: Page 2 retains query and shows 21–38, with Previous and no Next.
actual: Observed page=1, 18 rows, Previous only.

steps: From page 2 submit a different query.
expected: Pagination resets to first page.
actual: W 36 St search reset URL to no page parameter and displayed 1–20.

steps: Open result for 1104 Paw; use Back to search results; refresh results.
expected: Correct property opens; query is retained on return and refresh.
actual: ID 736302; query 1104 Paw retained.

steps: From home type and select a suggestion; use browser Back.
expected: Typed query is retained so the user can revise it.
actual: Home returned with a blank input after selecting 1102 Paw. The property-page Back to search results link does preserve context. F08.

steps: Open a result on page 2; return; use browser Forward/Back.
expected: Page, query, row and useful scroll position restore consistently.
actual: Page-zero return checked; page-two history and scroll restoration pending.

steps: Activate Market value help with mouse and keyboard; press Escape.
expected: Readable explanation appears and Escape dismisses it.
actual: Tooltip explains source-year Jan 1 market estimate and distinguishes tax bill; Escape dismissed.

steps: Inspect result summaries, row identity, currency and source labels.
expected: Each row has unambiguous address/ID, formatted currency and a dated source.
actual: Observed across exact, fuzzy and multi-result pages. Missing city falls back to ZIP. Not a source-data reconciliation.

steps: Use approved public fixtures for parks, $35 records and other excluded classes in suggestions and submitted search.
expected: Published exclusion policy is applied consistently; valid residential records remain searchable.
actual: No authoritative excluded-property fixtures available in this run.

steps: Join expected fixture IDs and displayed values to the selected certified release; compare property detail.
expected: Source year, value and identity agree; missing values are not displayed as zero.
actual: ID and home/detail consistency observed; current TCAD or database reconciliation not executed.

steps: Open a bookmarked page beyond final pagination; then change query.
expected: Useful empty-page recovery and a first-page link; no trapped empty state.

steps: Measure final-keystroke → correct suggestion rendered for known prefixes; log query and cache state.
expected: Meets approved suggestion latency target with no stale results.
actual: Six natural samples 16–752 ms. Mixed cache state and tool overhead; not p95 certification.

steps: Measure submit → correct results settled; repeat exact address and ID six times.
expected: Correct results on every run; compare against approved budget.
actual: Six additional warm-session samples 1196–1496 ms, all correct. Limited sample; full percentile gate pending.

steps: Run the performance protocol below: fresh-session and warm cases with controlled network, 20+ samples per query class.
expected: p50/p95, error rate and budgets reported separately by environment and cache state.

steps: Type characters 50 ms apart, 150 ms apart, then 500 ms apart; observe request count.
expected: Configured debounce works; rapid burst issues one final request after the debounce interval; no duplicate Enter request.
actual: The loading label was visible; request count and exact debounce not instrumented.

steps: Inject suggestion 500, 429 and timeout separately; submit the query normally.
expected: Suggestions fail gracefully; main search remains usable; no failure represented as no matches.

steps: Inject submitted-search 500, disconnect, timeout and reconnect.
expected: Honest error, retained query, bounded wait, usable retry; no indefinite spinner.

steps: Slow results, then double-click Search, press Enter repeatedly and edit query while pending.
expected: No duplicate navigation; latest intended query wins; pending state remains understandable.

steps: Measure initial home rendering, input responsiveness and layout shifts under standard and slow mobile profiles.
expected: Meet approved rendering/input/layout budgets; no search displacement while typing.
actual: No Lighthouse, network waterfall or real-user metrics captured.

steps: Inspect search label, combobox/listbox association, expanded state, status, image alt text and page language.
expected: Semantics exist and track actual state.
actual: Labels, status, lang=en, logo alt, expanded state and active option confirmed; screen-reader behavior pending.

steps: Complete home→suggestion→property→results with keyboard only; include Skip to content.
expected: Logical focus order and visible focus; results announced; no traps.
actual: Selection, submit, Escape and modal focus restoration work; complete sequence and screen reader not tested. F06 affects CTA focus.

steps: Run NVDA/Chrome and VoiceOver/Safari for loading, suggestions, no-results, error, tooltip and dialog.
expected: Names, counts, selection and route changes are announced once at useful times.

steps: Measure all text/control contrast, focus visibility, 200% zoom, 400% reflow, target sizes and text spacing.
expected: Meet the team’s approved accessibility standard, including no clipped or hidden controls.
actual: No formal conformance claim from screenshots alone.

steps: At widths 320, 375/390, 768, 1024 and 1440, inspect every home and search state.
expected: No horizontal overflow, clipped text, overlapping suggestions or unusable controls; column/header alignment holds.
actual: Available live viewport was 1363 × 936. Resize/zoom attempts did not change it.

steps: On iOS Safari and Android Chrome, type with software keyboard, select suggestions, scroll and rotate.
expected: Search and suggestion list remain usable above keyboard; tap targets and dismissal work.

steps: Repeat smoke suite in current Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari; record versions.
expected: Same identities, navigation and input behaviors; no browser-specific clipping.
actual: Cloud Chrome session exercised; other browsers not available.

steps: Review application console errors during the run and record failing requests separately.
expected: No application errors; infrastructure/extension errors classified separately.
actual: No application warn/error messages in inspected last 200 entries after excluding chrome-extension messages. Not an exhaustive network audit.

steps: In isolated fixtures switch post-protest, preliminary, protest and next-year release states.
expected: Hero/example/current-release text and search source remain consistent; unavailable data has clear fallbacks.
actual: Only 2026 certified/post-protest live state observed.

steps: Test benign special characters and encoded input in an isolated environment; inspect rendering.
expected: Search text is treated as text; no markup execution or query leakage in error content.
actual: Security testing was not performed in this live UI review.
